_doc: Venue ownership + pod-transport registry (racecontrol-layer). The single source of truth for whether RaceControl manages a venue's pods over Tailscale SSH (own) or installer/rc-sentry-exec only (sold). Keyed by venue_id; node roles per VENUE-NODE-ROLE-TAXONOMY.md. Read by scripts/pod-mgmt.mjs. Pairs with the installer venue-type axis (RCA + PR #131, .planning/specs/v2/rc-installer/). Declarative data, NOT compiled per-venue — the binary stays identical across venues (config.rs invariant).

_transports.tailscale-ssh: control_node -> pod directly via key-only SSH over Tailscale (own venues). Needs the control-node key bootstrapped onto the pod (Phase 1 / installer provision_ssh).
_transports.tailscale-rc-sentry: control_node -> pod :8091/exec over Tailscale (own-venue fallback; audited; survives sshd breakage).
_transports.heart-exec: control_node -> venue_heart pod_exec proxy -> rc-sentry -> pod (sold venues; no direct tailnet to pods). Audited + command-filtered at the heart.

_template-sold.name: Third-party venue template (copy + fill per sale)
